title: Sunset Sail Cruise
text: It was a wonderful trip and definitely for the books. I will definitely recommend to book this in advance should you plan to visit Barcelona.
author: Anne_R

title: Sunset on a boat in BCN
text: Really great experience whilst having 2hours on board, having drinks and getting an awesome sunset! Music on the background, nice crew who took polaroid photos for us (awesome surprise) and awesome vibes and tides :) thank you and see you soon again!
author: renee10m

title: A wonderful experience
text: the experience was perfect, I went with my husband and we celebrated our second anniversary there, the staff were very professional and attentive, recommended if you want to swim and enjoy a beautiful view.
author: kathelingl

title: Perfect for a summer plan
text: Excellent experience, we went for our second anniversary with my wife and it was perfect, the views, the attention from the staff and the professionalism were very good, 100% recommended
author: D7871GSjonatanl

title: Swim at Sunset
text: Warm and customer oriented lovely staff with charcuterie and beverages for all.  Nice small group of 10-12 people all enjoying the last light of the day over the  water.  The swim was incredible
author: Sbacskai

title: A fantastic experience!
text: I loved the experience, the sunset sailboat ride is a wonder, the crew was very friendly. I recommend it 100%
author: luciatL5695PG

title: Sunset Cruise
text: Amazing experience and a very accommodating staff! 10/10

title: Great captain, very...

title: Captain Arnold is the best!!!
text: Our captain arnold was amazing. Knowledgeable and friendly. A real gem!!  We enjoyed the entire experience.
